beats.label: The trial
beats.text: **365** adults, ages **55-80,** at higher risk of **Alzheimer's.**

beats.label: The dose
beats.text: Half took **2,000** **mg** of **DHA** daily. Half took a **placebo.**
beats.note: DHA is a main omega-3 in fish oil.

beats.label: At 6 months
beats.text: It **reached** the brain: DHA in spinal fluid rose about **17%.**

beats.label: Brain scans
beats.text: Shrinkage of the **hippocampus,** a memory hub, looked about the **same.**

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: **One** dose, **one** group: older adults who rarely ate fish. Other uses **weren't** tested.
beats.note: Ask a doctor before changing supplements.
